The Three Classes at a Glance

Crystalline

Repeating unit cells ? long-range order ? sharp T_m with a temperature plateau (latent heat), anisotropic cleavage, brittle.

Amorphous

Frozen random network ? no T_m; gradual softening through the glass transition T_g; isotropic conchoidal fracture.

Polymeric

Entangled macromolecular chains (± folded crystallites) ? T_g then rubbery plateau, chain uncoiling ? elasticity, necking & plastic draw.
